features: Eagle Eye Cloud Managed Video Recorder (CMVR): stores video locally and acts as a gateway to the Eagle Eye cloud
Video encrypted in transit and at rest
Datasheet: Bridges and CMVRs support ONVIF Profile S IP cameras
Max cameras: up to 50 IP cameras @4MP (typical)
LPR support: Yes (2023 datasheet: up to 4 LPR cameras)
Storage capacity: 64 TB (raw), 48 TB (useable) RAID 5 per 2025 datasheet; 2023 datasheet states 40TB (raw), 30TB (useable) RAID 5
Conflict: network port speed stated as Dual Gigabit in the 2023 datasheet and Dual 2.5 Gigabit in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
Conflict: video output stated as HDMI (1), VGA (1), DP (1) in the 2023 datasheet and HDMI (2), DP (2) in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
Conflict: dimensions stated as 437 x 503 x 43 mm in the 2023 datasheet and 483 x 559 x 45 mm in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
Conflict: maximum power consumption stated as 160 W in the 2023 datasheet and 500 W in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
